fix: Ship the real Rollup browser bundle in dist/browser/index.js (and its index.d.ts) instead of the 98-byte stub published in jimp@1.6.1, so bundlers that resolve the "browser" export condition get Jimp, ResizeStrategy, etc.
changes: turbo.json: build:browser now depends on the same package's build and declares dist/browser/** as an output, so tshy cannot overwrite the Rollup bundle and turbo cache hits restore it.

Tarball: dist/browser/index.js (708 KB bundle) and dist/browser/index.d.ts (117 KB) replace the stubs; the shipped dist/browser/index.js.map is the same size as the one already published in 1.6.1. Other files match the published 1.6.1 tarball.
verification: Reproduced the bug: with the original turbo.json, a cached rebuild produces the same 98-byte stub that was published; with the fix it produces the real bundle.

Bundling import { Jimp, ResizeStrategy } from "jimp" with esbuild (platform=browser) yields defined exports, and the browser bundle creates, resizes and PNG-encodes an image; with upstream 1.6.1 esbuild fails with "No matching export in node_modules/jimp/dist/browser/index.js for import Jimp" (other bundlers silently yield undefined).
